item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop controlled probes of whether recommendations depend on recent, repeated interests or incidental history. Compare removal of recent, repeated, and isolated interactions against length-matched random removals; measure ranking changes and connect failures to sequence encoding and temporal weighting. Use training-history prefixes without altering benchmark splits.","query":"sequential recommendation counterfactual diagnostics history deletion recency repeated interests perturbation faithfulness temporal shortcut learning 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Build evidence-grounded diagnostics for broad relatedness, unsupported compatibility, and redundant recommendations using only available titles, descriptions, and histories. Seek methods that distinguish explicit contradictory evidence from missing information, validate against qualitative feedback, and avoid treating an interaction as proof of ownership or continuing demand.","query":"recommendation diagnostics evidence grounded compatibility prerequisites redundancy intent mismatch selective prediction abstention item descriptions user feedback 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Replace scale-dependent training margins with trustworthy ranking diagnostics. Investigate disagreement between sampled-candidate and full-catalog rankings, popularity and history-length slices, user-level uncertainty, and controlled fault injection. Calibrate probes against the fixed validation HR@10 while accounting for four-category macro averaging, repeated validation reuse, and the small qualitative-feedback sample.","query":"recommender diagnostic validation sampled ranking full catalog evaluation popularity bias bootstrap uncertainty metric sensitivity fault injection adaptive validation overfitting 2024 2025 2026"}]}
